description: Golden set for the grounded support bot. Contexts describe a FICTIONAL store policy so the model cannot answer from pre-training — any correct answer must come from the context, which is what makes faithfulness meaningful.

cases.question: How many days do I have to return an item?
context: Sauce Demo Store accepts returns within 45 days of delivery.
Returned items must be unused and in original packaging.
Refunds are issued to the original payment method within 5 business days of receiving the return.
cases.expected_answer: You can return an item within 45 days of delivery, as long as it is unused and in its original packaging.

cases.question: Is shipping free?
context: Standard shipping costs $4.99 for orders under $75.
Orders of $75 or more ship free with standard shipping.
Express shipping costs $14.99 regardless of order size.
cases.expected_answer: Standard shipping is free for orders of $75 or more; otherwise it costs $4.99. Express shipping is always $14.99.

cases.question: What does the Bike Light warranty cover?
context: The Sauce Labs Bike Light has a 2-year limited warranty.
The warranty covers manufacturing defects and battery failure.
The warranty does not cover water damage or accidental drops.
cases.expected_answer: The Bike Light has a 2-year limited warranty covering manufacturing defects and battery failure, but not water damage or accidental drops.

cases.question: When can I reach customer support?
context: Customer support is available Monday to Friday, 8am to 6pm Central European Time.
Support is closed on weekends and public holidays.
Urgent order issues can be reported any time via the in-app chat and are answered next business day.
cases.expected_answer: Customer support is available Monday to Friday from 8am to 6pm Central European Time and is closed on weekends and public holidays.

unanswerable.question: How many loyalty points do I earn per dollar?
context: Sauce Demo Store accepts returns within 45 days of delivery.
Standard shipping costs $4.99 for orders under $75.
unanswerable.expected_answer: I don't know based on the provided information.
